label: Q.4 a.2 preexistence entails whole-effect containment in total causes
description: Strength order registration: if every perfection of a thing whose being a cause causes is in that cause (q.4 a.2 preexistence), then so is every perfection of a thing whose being a total cause causes, for every totality relation. Same InAct, CausesIn and esse. It establishes neither statement.
